title: Games made with Unity: June 2026 in review
summary: Stay updated with the latest game releases from the Unity community. Explore our list of standout games made with Unity in June 2026.
body_markdown:
***June was a big month for Unity games: both* 33 Immortals *and* Zenless Zone Zero *hit their full 1.0 releases, Unity sponsored Day of the Devs at Summer Games Fest — featuring world premieres from across the Unity community — and developers showed up in force for Steam Next Fest and the Wholesome Direct. Get the recap in our summary of Made with Unity games for June 2026.***


## **Made with Unity at Day of the Devs: Summer Game Fest 2026**


Unity was proud to sponsor Day of the Devs at Summer Game Fest 2026. The Made with Unity games featured include:


### **World premieres**


- [Lazy River](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2743290/Lazy_River/) by Mike Boxleiter and team
- [Ithaca](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2156800/Ithaca/) by The Pixel Hunt
- [Super Yooka-Laylee Kart](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348210/Super_YookaLaylee_Kart/) by Playtonic Games
- [Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It!](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3564410/Floor_Plan_Slap_Out_Of_It/) by Turbo Button
- [Bub](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4762110/Bub/) by Paperfrog
- [Apple Crumble](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4110770/Apple_Crumble/) by Happy Broccoli Games


### **Also featured**


- [Prove You're Human](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4533950/Prove_Youre_Human/) by sunset visitor 斜陽過客
- [The Free Shepherd](https://store.steampowered.com/app/939530/The_Free_Shepherd/) by Frame Interactive
- [Shot One Fighters](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2945040/Shot_One_Fighters/) by Red Moon Workshop
- [33 Immortals](https://store.steampowered.com/app/958520/33_Immortals/) by Thunder Lotus
- [Screenbound](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805070/Screenbound/) by Crescent Moon Games, Radical Forge


Wishlist these exciting games and more on[Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/sale/DayoftheDevsSummerGamesFest2026) .
